text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C below my average cost turned a paper loss into a realized loss; before selling, I should reassess its outlook and the reason I bought it, not react to the loss alone.","Selling part of Stock B at a gain and Stock D above my average cost shows the value of setting position-size and profit-taking rules in advance, rather than making isolated trades.","My account value has barely grown over these periods despite several trades, so I should judge progress against my apartment goal and a suitable long-term benchmark, not the excitement of individual wins."]}
